title: VideoGuard latency-bounded drift events
protocol: Frozen160-frame trajectories,5 challenging groups×120 clips; fixed validated detector configs. Require both800ms boundary tolerance and500/1000/1500/2000ms emitted-alarm delay. One-to-one chronological DP matching.
findings: A good retrospective boundary can still miss a real-time deadline; explicit late alarms lose credit.
No future-window lookahead or new thresholds tuned on test.
Reanalysis of existing clips, not independent new media or real-video evidence.
scope: AI-assisted new local stress experiments; no retraining, external API, private data or production claim
